description.short: Check in, raise blockers and answer nudges without leaving Teams.
description.full: OpenOKR runs the OKR practice. This app lets a member check in on a goal, raise a blocker during a session, and act on the reminders the Coach and the Champion send, all from Teams. Every command is the same one the browser offers and is checked the same way.

commands.title: checkin
commands.description: Check in on a goal you champion

commands.title: status
commands.description: The health and progress of one goal

commands.title: blocker
commands.description: Raise a blocker in the running session

commands.title: commit
commands.description: Add a commitment to the running session

commands.title: ask
commands.description: Ask a question about this workspace

commands.title: snooze
commands.description: Stop being messaged about one thing
